title: Space-filling surfaces: sharp Hölder continuous parameterizations from squares to cubes
summary: Following a hint of Semmes, we employ Stong's bijections between integer lattices to construct space-filling surfaces, which are higher-dimensional analogues of space-filling curves. For each $m\geq 2$ we build $α$-Hölder continuous parameterizations $f:[0,1]^m\rightarrow[0,1]^{m+1}$ with sharp exponent $α=m/(m+1)$. In particular, there exist $(2/3)$-Hölder continuous surjections from squares to cubes. This solves Arnold's problem 1988--5.
